# Aabenraa Mave- og Tarmsygd.

Aabenraa Mave- og Tarmsygd. is a gastrointestinal and colorectal surgery department included in the Danish national quality registry for inflammatory bowel disease (DANIBD). The department is notable for achieving a re-operation rate of 0% for surgical procedures, which falls below the development target of 8% [^src1]. This metric is part of DANIBD's annual performance assessment, which tracks surgical quality by measuring the proportion of patients requiring reoperation within 30 days of primary surgical intervention for inflammatory bowel disease [^src1].

The department appears in DANIBD's 2024 annual report as part of a broader national effort to monitor and improve the quality of care for inflammatory bowel disease patients across Denmark [^src1]. The low re-operation rate suggests either favorable surgical outcomes or a patient case mix with lower complication risk; contextually, the 8% target represents the expected development benchmark for this quality indicator across the Danish healthcare system [^src1].
